title: Saudi Arabia Aims to Deter Red Sea Attacks With New Coalition
summary_full: Facing attacks by Yemen’s Houthi militia, Saudi Arabia has invited dozens of countries to assist it in protecting shipping in the Red Sea, diplomats say.
